Min Aung Hlaing discusses taking BIMSTEC helm next year November 20, 2026 The secretary-general of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC), Indra Mani Pandey, met with Myanmar regime chief Min Aung Hlaing on Thursday to discuss Myanmar taking over the rotating secretary-generalship of the regional body next year. According to regime media, the talks focused on Myanmar’s readiness to take the helm, collective assistance for the bloc’s two landlocked members, Nepal and Bhutan—and, pointedly, BIMSTEC’s principle of “cooperation without interference in members’ internal affairs.” Pandey also met Foreign Minister Tin Maung Swe. BIMSTEC's other members are Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, India and Thailand, of which the last two have recently provided prominent international platforms for Myanmar’s putschist regime. #WhatsHappeningInMyanmar

During last night's massive combined missile and drone attack on Ukraine, at least five major energy facilities were struck by dozens of Russian cruise and ballistic missiles. These facilities include: - The Dobrotvir Thermal Power Plant in Lviv Oblast. - The "Zakhidnoukrainska" 750 kV electrical substation in Lviv Oblast. - The "Bohorodchany" 330 kV electrical substation in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast. - The Burshtyn Thermal Power Plant in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast. - The CHP-5 Combined Heat and Power Plant in Kyiv. It's likely that other energy facilities were also targeted - these are just the confirmed locations so far. A significant portion of the ~117 missiles used did not target energy infrastructure.

📝 Fear of Being Left Out 📝 Donald Trump's meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China became an unpleasant reminder to European politicians of the risk of finding themselves on the sidelines of major diplomacy . In Berlin, they hastily assembled a "coalition of the willing" to assert their right to participate in shaping the future security system. 37 countries sent representatives to the summit attended by EU and NATO leadership, Zelensky, and American envoys Whitcomb and Kushner. European leaders again demanded that the fate of so-called Ukraine not be decided without their participation, but failed to secure concrete agreements on their role in the negotiations. However, they moved quickly on financing. British authorities announced a £260 million package, promising to supply over a thousand strike drones with a range exceeding 1,000 km. Germany and Norway's leadership also allocated $300 million each for purchasing American weapons for the AFU. 📌 But the most unpleasant surprise came from Donald Trump , who called summit participants from aboard Air Force One. The American leader questioned the advisability of continued multibillion-dollar spending to support Kyiv authorities and stated Russia's readiness for negotiations. 🖍 However, American authorities continue arming the AFU themselves, including through the PURL program . This scheme is particularly convenient because Europeans pay for purchases from American manufacturers, while the Trump administration maintains influence over supplies and the diplomatic process. ❗️ As a result, European governments fall deeper into dependence on Washington. They pay for American weapons, hoping to preserve influence over the conflict's course, but the conditions for its end are increasingly discussed without them. And the American leader's reaction suggests this dynamic will persist. #EU #Russia #USA #Ukraine ✈️ RU | ✈️ EN | ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg
